selection.method: Sort designs within each family by SHA-256(seed/id); take the first N. Select one view per design with the same rank. No detector outcomes or image labels enter selection.

alignedDiagnosticComparison.method: Render both exported pairs independently at 1536 pixels, project the same 512x512 canonical material samples into each saved crop, and score only their common observed region. Report excluded coverage and allow one global color flip per pair.

remainingIssues.issue: A faint lower-right diagonal seam remains in separate exported curves. Shared-cut recovery rejects the proposed merge for higher-resolution image error despite passing aggregate checks.
The fit uses 3+2 cuts instead of the source pair's 2+2.
remainingIssues.oracleEvidence: Replacing only automatic corners with source corners yields a checked matching 2+2 pair. The original count search had considered 2+2 but ranked it below 3+2.

remainingIssues.issue: High-amplitude illumination stripes across the paper itself exposed additional failures. The failed fixture source and run are retained; this robustness is not claimed.

extraCutOracleIntervention.scope: Oracle-crop intervention on the extra-cut case. Known source corners replace the automatic crop; no ground-truth curves enter the fitter. This is not an automatic recovery result.
